newsitem.title: UK: MECP approached Greycoat investors - paper.
newsitem.headline: MECP approached Greycoat investors - paper.

text.p: Britain's MEPC Plc approached leading shareholders in fellow property company Greycoat Plc about buying their stakes but was rebuffed because the offer price was too low, the Financial Times newspaper said on Monday.
The newspaper said MEPC approached at least three of Greycoat's largest institutional investors about selling their stakes at 190 pence per share.
The institutions were understood to have told MEPC that the price was too low and did not reflect expected gains from four large London developments, said the Financial Times.

The newspaper quoted Greycoat chief executive Peter Thornton as saying MEPC's approach to shareholders was "news to us. If they are offering cash for the company, it would have to be at the right price".
